posts.text: Texas governor Greg Abbott asked the Texas Supreme Court to expel the democratic house members who walked out to prevent a vote on the redrawn congressional district maps. The state Supreme Court rejected his request, the siding that any expulsion would need to come directly from a house vote

The White House just published a document that outlines national security priorities for the U.S. government.  It contains new categories of focus that should concern Americans, because it could make dissent and exercise of the first amendment more difficult

Speaker of the House Mike Johnson suggested that members of the U.S. Congress should be allowed to buy and sell stock because their salary hasn’t changed since 2009 and they need to “take care of their families”.  That’s called insider trading: lawmakers create the policies that affect how the companies whose stock they trade perform.

Spencer Pratt is running for mayor of Los Angeles and many think they’re funny when they say “I’m going to Los Angeles to vote for him, because California has no voter ID laws.” But the truth is that California law already has mechanism to check eligibility. Let’s fact check @Jesus Saves

During his trip to China, Trump was treated by the Chinese government to an elaborate reception with flag waving and a red carpet roll out. Does this mean that President Trump is more respected than other presidents around the world? After all, President Obama did not receive such a reception. Let’s fact, check claims like the one by @🇺🇸Jenn🇺🇸

The Department of Justice is reportedly considering settling Trump’s $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS. The settlement might include money paid to Trump and his family, and an agreement that would stop all audits of Trump, his family, and his businesses.

Does US Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum know how solar power works? Doug Burgum, the Trump administration’s secretary of the interior, drew mocking comments during a congressional hearing, when he said that solar power doesn’t work at night.

Tennessee House Republicans have removed democratic lawmakers from committees and subcommittees, after their protests about the redrawn congressional maps that removed Tennessee’s only Black majority congressional district.

One out of every four republican men said that they would lose, when asked who would win a confrontation between them and 80-year old President Donald Trump.  This is vastly different from the answer democratic women gave.

You should know that, when someone like Nick Fuentes endorses a Democratic party gubernatorial candidate like Amy Acton over Vivek Ramaswamy, something is up.  And yet, people like @𝕻𝖆𝖙𝖗𝖎𝖔𝖙𝕯𝖆𝖉ᵉᵛ1.0 think that this just proves alignment in values.
